svg.title: Every policy across the 8 environment categories
svg.desc: Mean normalized reward per step over the final 100,928 steps of the 1,000,000-step best recording, one axis per declared category with its environment count, the better of Random and the constant do-nothing policy at 0 and Oracle at 1. The radius has two linear bands: the inner 30 percent runs from -1.00 at the centre to the floor, and the outer 70 percent from the floor to the Oracle. A category mean below the centre breaks the outline of its policy at that axis and is printed under the axis label. Outlines only: the polygon area is not the score. The overall ranking is the equal-weight mean over all 245 environments.

g.text: Mean normalized reward per step · 245 environments · best recording 73d32d36a
Equal weight per environment · outlines, not areas · floor = max(Random, Constant) = 0 · Oracle = 1 · final 100,928 of 1,000,000 steps
Radius in two linear bands: the inner 30% runs from −1.00 at the centre to the floor, the outer 70% from the floor to the Oracle; below the chart: Random on prediction at −5.98.
